translations.web: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke like a dragon.
translations.bsb: Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth. This beast had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translations.kjv: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.
translations.asv: And I saw another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like unto lamb, and he spake as a dragon.
